/*selectMasterWmCoMbrcmpyPopList*/ SELECT '구매대행구매사 전체' AS BUYER_NAME, '구매대행' AS BUYER, '구매대행구매사' AS IRS_NO, '구매대행' BUYER_CODE, '2' AS SEQ FROM DUAL UNION ALL SELECT /*+INDEX(CM ICOMCMPY_PK)*/ CM.COM_NAME_LOC AS BUYER_NAME, CM.COM_CODE AS BUYER, CM.IRS_NO AS IRS_NO, CM.COM_CODE BUYER_CODE, '3' AS SEQ FROM ICOMCMPY CM
WHERE CM.COM_CODE IN (SELECT /*+LEADING(W) USE_NL(W P) INDEX(W WMSIVDT_05)*/ P.BUYER FROM ICOMPODT P, ICOMPOHD H, WMSIVDT W WHERE P.PROCESS_TYPE IN('1','2','3') AND (P.WAREHOUSE_CODE = '${st_warehouse_code}' OR H.AGENT = '${st_wareHouse_agent}') AND W.INV_DATE BETWEEN '${st_from_date}' AND '${st_to_date}' AND P.STATUS <> 'D' AND H.STATUS <> 'D' AND W.STATUS(+) <> 'D' AND W.WAREHOUSE_CODE(+) = '${st_warehouse_code}' AND P.BUYER = W.BUYER(+) AND P.PO_NO = W.PO_NO(+) AND P.PO_SEQ = W.PO_SEQ(+) AND P.BUYER = H.BUYER AND P.PO_NO = H.PO_NO )
WHERE CM.COM_CODE IN (SELECT /*+LEADING(W) USE_NL(W P) INDEX(W WMSIVDT_05)*/ P.BUYER FROM ICOMPODT P, ICOMPOHD H, WMSIVDT W WHERE P.PROCESS_TYPE IN('1','2','3') AND (P.WAREHOUSE_CODE ='${st_warehouse_code}' OR H.AGENT = '${st_wareHouse_agent}') AND W.DELIVERY_DATE BETWEEN '${st_from_date}' AND '${st_to_date}' AND P.STATUS <> 'D' AND H.STATUS <> 'D' AND W.STATUS(+) <> 'D' AND W.WAREHOUSE_CODE(+) = '${st_warehouse_code}' AND P.BUYER = W.BUYER(+) AND P.PO_NO = W.PO_NO(+) AND P.PO_SEQ = W.PO_SEQ(+) AND P.BUYER = H.BUYER AND P.PO_NO = H.PO_NO )
WHERE CM.COM_CODE IN (SELECT /*+LEADING(W) USE_NL(W P) INDEX(W WMSIVDT_05)*/ P.BUYER FROM ICOMPODT P, ICOMPOHD H, WMSIVDT W WHERE P.PROCESS_TYPE IN('1','2','3') AND (P.WAREHOUSE_CODE ='${st_warehouse_code}' OR H.AGENT = '${st_wareHouse_agent}') AND W.SCHEDULED_DATE BETWEEN '${st_from_date}' AND '${st_to_date}' AND P.STATUS <> 'D' AND H.STATUS <> 'D' AND W.STATUS(+) <> 'D' AND W.WAREHOUSE_CODE(+) = '${st_warehouse_code}' AND P.BUYER = W.BUYER(+) AND P.PO_NO = W.PO_NO(+) AND P.PO_SEQ = W.PO_SEQ(+) AND P.BUYER = H.BUYER AND P.PO_NO = H.PO_NO )
WHERE CM.COM_CODE IN (SELECT /*+LEADING(P H)*/ P.BUYER FROM ICOMPODT P, ICOMPOHD H WHERE P.PROCESS_TYPE IN('1','2','3') AND (P.WAREHOUSE_CODE ='${st_warehouse_code}' OR H.AGENT = '${st_wareHouse_agent}') AND P.RD_DATE BETWEEN '${st_from_date}' AND '${st_to_date}' AND P.STATUS <> 'D' AND H.STATUS <> 'D' AND P.BUYER = H.BUYER AND P.PO_NO = H.PO_NO )
WHERE CM.COM_CODE IN (SELECT /*+LEADING(H) USE_NL(H P)*/ P.BUYER FROM ICOMPODT P, ICOMPOHD H WHERE P.PROCESS_TYPE IN('1','2','3') AND (P.WAREHOUSE_CODE ='${st_warehouse_code}' OR H.AGENT = '${st_wareHouse_agent}') AND H.PO_CREATE_DATE BETWEEN '${st_from_date}' AND '${st_to_date}' AND P.STATUS <> 'D' AND H.STATUS <> 'D' AND P.BUYER = H.BUYER AND P.PO_NO = H.PO_NO )
WHERE CM.COM_CODE IN (SELECT /*+LEADING(H) USE_NL(H P)*/ P.BUYER FROM ICOMPODT P, ICOMPOHD H WHERE P.PROCESS_TYPE IN('1','2','3') AND (P.WAREHOUSE_CODE ='${st_warehouse_code}' OR H.AGENT = '${st_wareHouse_agent}') AND H.PO_CREATE_DATE BETWEEN '${st_from_date}' AND '${st_to_date}' AND P.STATUS <> 'D' AND H.STATUS <> 'D' AND P.BUYER = H.BUYER AND P.PO_NO = H.PO_NO )
AND CM.COM_NAME_LOC LIKE '%'||'${st_com_name}'||'%'
ORDER BY 5,1
